title: Container Diagram
alt: Runtime modules within the Praetor binary, daemon services, and configuration inputs.
text: Repository Space: .standards.yaml (Manifest, repo-layer), .config/fleet.yaml (fleet-layer, optional), .config/orgs/*.yaml (org-layer, optional), AGENTS.md (Instructions), .agents/ (Personas, Skills).

Praetor Core Engine (Go Binary / Container): CLI & Servers (cmd/standardsctl, mcp, lsp), HTTP Health Probes (praetorctl serve), Gating Engine, Compiler & Transpiler, HISS Invariant Scanner, Runner Matrix Router, Bump Canary, SARIF Distiller, Model Router.
Generated Projections: Vendor Agent Files (CLAUDE.md, etc.), Diagnostic Summary (SARIF output), Distroless Image (ghcr.io/cordanallm/praetor).
.standards.yaml → Gating Engine (lockfile policy).
.standards.yaml → Runner Matrix Router (repo layer, wins).
.config/fleet.yaml → Runner Matrix Router (fleet layer).
.config/orgs/*.yaml → Runner Matrix Router (org layer).
AGENTS.md → Compiler & Transpiler.
.agents/ → Compiler & Transpiler.
CLI & Servers → Gating Engine.
CLI & Servers → Compiler & Transpiler.
Gating Engine → HISS Invariant Scanner.
Compiler & Transpiler → Vendor Agent Files.
Bump Canary → SARIF Distiller (wraps failure as SARIF) → Diagnostic Summary.
HTTP Health Probes → Distroless Image (packaged in).

Scenario 1, compile-context: Compiles AGENTS.md and .agents/ to vendor-specific instructions. Reads AGENTS.md. Reads .agents/ personas and skills (agents.go persona projection). Renders 6 vendor files (CLAUDE.md, etc.).
Scenario 2, gating: Anti-Direct-Merge Gating Pipeline. Runs praetorctl gate run. Reads policy and verifies lockfiles. 6 stages including HISS.

Scenario 3, runner routing: Resolves runners using hierarchical policy; CI itself runs on GitHub-hosted runners and does not consume this result (ADR-0012). DefaultRunnerPolicy merges fleet.yaml first. Then .config/orgs/<org>.yaml overrides fleet. Then .standards.yaml runners: overrides fleet and org (LoadCascadingRunnerConfigContext, last write wins).
Scenario 4, SARIF distillation: Condenses SARIF logs into bounded summaries. Canary test wraps failure in SARIF. Distills summary and writes full report.
The CLI routes commands to internal engines.
SARIF Distillation condenses failure outputs for the agent.
